approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would allow the Minister to share Australian travel document data through automated identity-matching services agreed between the Commonwealth, states and territories.
It would amend the Australian Passports Act 2005 to add a new purpose for disclosing information and let the Minister authorise computer programs to make certain decisions.
The bill would also allow computer-made decisions to be substituted if incorrect, without affecting the reviewability of decisions about travel documents.
Adds a new purpose for disclosing information under the Passports Act to participate in identity-matching services.
Allows the Minister to arrange for computer programs to make decisions under the Passports Act.
Provides that computer-made decisions may be substituted if incorrect.
The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Commonwealth, state and territory agencies, and individuals whose identity information is used in the services.
